indicators.name: Road fatalities
indicators.description: Persons killed in road traffic accidents, including those who die within 30 days of the accident.

indicators.name: Average population
indicators.description: Average population of the reference year (mean of 1 January populations of two consecutive years).

indicators.name: Road fatalities per million inhabitants
indicators.description: Road fatalities divided by average population, multiplied by 1,000,000.
indicators.derivation: road_fatalities / population_average * 1e6, rounded to 1 decimal. Status is the most cautious of the two inputs.
